name: Semira
title: Son of Asher
summary: Semira (also known as Shimron or Jimna in some translations) was one of the sons of Asher, son of Jacob. He is mentioned in the genealogies in Genesis and 1 Chronicles as part of Asher's descendants who went down to Egypt with Jacob and his family.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned among the sons of Asher
keyEvents.description: Semira is listed as one of the sons of Asher in the genealogy of Jacob's descendants who went to Egypt.

keyEvents.title: The Genealogy in Numbers
keyEvents.description: The sons of Asher, including Semira, are mentioned in the census of the tribes of Israel in the wilderness.

keyEvents.title: Recorded in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Semira is listed in the detailed genealogy of the tribe of Asher in 1 Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: Jacob's Family Goes to Egypt
keyEvents.description: Semira was among the seventy people in Jacob's household who went down to Egypt during the famine, marking the beginning of Israel's stay there.
